originalInput.context: Library analyst publishing whole-credit activity allocations by branch.
originalInput.assumption: Synthetic nonnegative reporting quantities in one common unit. Integer totals have been approved independently; no change to underlying source measurements.

warning: Controlled rounding is a publication transform, not correction of source measurements, statistical inference or privacy protection. Exact approved cells aggregate repeated records; absent cells are structural zero. Each published cell must be its exact floor or ceiling. Supplied row/column totals must be compatible rounded margins. Solver minimizes total absolute cell rounding error under those constraints; ties follow roster order. Independent-nearest baseline ignores margins and may have lower error but inconsistent totals. Holds remain in the audit and may make totals infeasible. Neural similarity is not confidence; inspect both axes. No uploads or ledger writes.
